name: Wasp Parts Reference Rhino Geometry via Params

solution.brief: Wasp parts require a paired .3dm file opened first; Brep, Points, and Curves are referenced into GH as part geometry and connection data.
solution.principle: Wasp externalizes part geometry to Rhino: GH definitions reference live Rhino objects via parameter components, so the correct .3dm must be open before the GH file solves. This separation keeps geometry editable in Rhino while logic lives in GH.

intents: how do I set up a Wasp part
Wasp definition is empty or giving errors
what geometry do I need for Wasp connections
how do I define connection planes for Wasp
Wasp part not working after opening GH file
symptoms: Wasp GH definition shows null or empty outputs
Param_Brep, Param_Point, or Param_Curve components are orange/red with no data
Wasp_Basic Part or Wasp_Connection From Direction produces no output
Opening a Wasp .gh file in isolation yields errors

preconditions: A paired Rhino .3dm file exists with part geometry (Brep) and connection geometry (Points at face centers, Curves for X-axis orientation) already modeled
The .3dm file must be open in Rhino before the GH definition is opened or solved
Geometry in Rhino must be correctly named/layered so GH parameter components can reference them
